Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 107, verse 1:

Naming of the Surah

• It is called al-Ma'un (the Small Kindnesses), because the word al-Ma'un occurs at its end, and this word does not occur in any other surah.

Some of the Aims of the Surah

• It mentions some of the characteristics of the disbelievers, such as not being kind to the orphan, and it mentions some of the characteristics of the hypocrites, such as delaying the prayer beyond its time and showing off in worship. It also censures and condemns both groups, and within this is a denunciation of their deeds and a warning against their characteristics.

[The Tafsir]

﴿Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?﴾ Have you considered the state of that person who denies the Resurrection and the Recompense?
Then that is the one who pushes away the orphan, the one whose father has died while he was young, roughly and harshly, denying him his right, because of the hardness of his heart.
And he does not urge others to feed the needy person who has nothing that suffices him and meets his need; so how could he feed it himself?
So a severe punishment awaits those who pray, who are heedless of their prayer, who do not perform it in its proper manner, and who do not offer it at its appointed time.

Those who make a show of their good deeds, doing them to be seen by people.
They withhold the lending of things whose lending does no harm, such as utensils and other items. So they neither did good in worshipping their Lord, nor did they do good to His creation.
